title: Kiss the Edge
tagline: Drift to the beat. The closer you cut it, the harder the music hits.

share.title: Kiss the Edge — drift to the beat
share.description: The closer you cut it, the harder the music hits. Can you reach OVERDRIVE?

seo.title: Kiss the Edge: One-Tap Drift Game · Play Free Online
seo.description: Play Kiss the Edge, a free one-tap neon drift game in your browser. Cut corners close to the edge and the synthwave soundtrack builds. No download.
seo.h1: Kiss the Edge: a one-tap neon drift game
seo.imageAlt: Kiss the Edge: a neon car drifting around a corner on a synthwave road
intro: Kiss the Edge is a free one-tap drift game you play right in your browser, on your phone or your computer. Your neon car slides through an endless road of hairpin corners and you steer with one finger: hold to drift right, let go to drift left.

The twist is the soundtrack. Every corner you take close to the edge adds a new layer to the synthwave music, so a great run literally sounds better and better until you hit OVERDRIVE. Cut it a little too close, though, and you're off the road.
howTo: Tap to start. The car is always moving, so you only choose which way it drifts.
Hold anywhere on the screen to drift right. Let go to drift left. On a computer, hold Space, the right arrow or Enter.
Take every corner as tight as you dare. Passing close to the edge scores GREAT (+2), PERFECT (+3) or INSANE! (+5). A wide, safe corner only scores +1 and resets your streak.
Chain close corners into a streak. At streaks of 2, 4, 7, 11 and 16 the music adds hi-hats, bass, chords, a melody and finally OVERDRIVE, where every corner is worth double.
Leave the road and the run is over. Tap anywhere to retry instantly.
controls: Phone or tablet
Hold the screen to drift right, release to drift left
Computer
Hold Space, → or Enter (or the mouse button) to drift right, release to drift left
Retry
Tap or click anywhere after a crash
tips: Your first runs tell you exactly when to HOLD and when to LET GO. Use them to feel the rhythm of the turns.
Turn in late. The closer your drift line passes the edge, the higher the grade.
A safe corner costs you your streak, but a crash costs you the whole run. When the music is at full OVERDRIVE, a GREAT is plenty.
Grab the gold coins on the road. Every run also pays one coin per 10 points.
Spend coins in the GARAGE on 8 cars, from ROOKIE to the rainbow PRISM.
Keep going to see new zones: SUNSET BLVD, MIDNIGHT, AURORA, VAPORWAVE, INFERNO and THE VOID.
faq: Is Kiss the Edge free?
Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.
Can I play Kiss the Edge on my phone?
Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with the keyboard or mouse.
Do I need sound on?
You can play muted, but the music is half the game: the soundtrack reacts to how close you drive. Turn it up.
What is OVERDRIVE?
Chain 16 close corners in a row and the full track kicks in. While you stay in OVERDRIVE, every corner scores double points.
Is my progress saved?
Your best score, coins and cars are saved in your browser on this device.

title: Frog Fling
tagline: Lick a firefly, swing, fling. Every anchor is a snack.

share.title: Frog Fling — lick, swing, fling
share.description: Lick a firefly, swing, fling. Skim the pond, dodge the pike. How far can you fling?

seo.title: Frog Fling: Frog Tongue Swing Game · Play Free Online
seo.description: Play Frog Fling free online: a one-tap frog tongue swing game. Hold to lick a firefly, swing, let go to fling over the pond. No download, works on phone.
seo.h1: Frog Fling: the frog tongue swing game
seo.imageAlt: Frog Fling: a frog swinging over a pond on its tongue from a firefly
intro: Frog Fling is a free one-tap swing game where the grappling hook is a frog's tongue. Hold to lick a firefly and swing from it, then let go to fling yourself across the pond. Play it right here in your browser on a phone or a computer.

There's a catch: every firefly you swing from gets eaten. You can never grab the same one twice, so every fling has to land you within reach of the next snack. Fall into the water and it's SPLASH. Hang around near the bubbles and the pike gets you.
howTo: Tap to start. Your frog jumps off the lily pad.
Hold anywhere on the screen to stick your tongue on the nearest firefly in reach. Keep holding to swing.
Let go to fling. Release while the frog is flying forward and upward for a PERFECT fling, a speed boost and a bigger combo.
Each firefly you swing from is gulped down (+1). PERFECT flings in a row add a combo bonus on top.
Swing all the way around for a LOOP (+3), DOUBLE LOOP (+6) or TRIPLE LOOP (+9).
Fall into the pond and the run ends. Tap anywhere to retry instantly.
controls: Phone or tablet
Hold the screen to lick and swing, release to fling
Computer
Hold Space, ↑ or Enter (or the mouse button) to lick and swing, release to fling
Retry
Tap or click anywhere after you splash
tips: Let go on the upswing, just past the bottom of the arc. That's where PERFECT lives.
Don't panic when you drop low. Skim the water and climb back out for a SKIM bonus (+2).
Bubbles in the water mean a pike is about to jump. Stay high over that gap.
Golden fireflies give you coins. Every run also pays one coin per 10 points.
Spend coins in the POND SHOP on 8 frogs, from CLASSIC to COSMIC.
Every 12 gulps the pond changes: SUNSET POND, DUSK, MOONLIGHT, MIDNIGHT BOG, AURORA and BLOOD MOON.
faq: Is Frog Fling free?
Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.
Can I play Frog Fling on my phone?
Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with the keyboard or mouse.
Why can't I grab the same firefly again?
Because the frog eats it. Every firefly you swing from is gone, which is what keeps each run moving forward.
How do I get a PERFECT fling?
Let go while the frog is moving forward and upward, at a decent speed. You'll see PERFECT! pop up and the frog gets a small boost.
Is my progress saved?
Your best score, coins and frogs are saved in your browser on this device.

title: Cat Stack
tagline: Drop sleepy cats from a swinging claw. Stack them to the moon. Don't wake the tower.

share.title: Cat Stack — stack cats to the moon
share.description: Drop sleepy cats from a swinging claw and stack them to the moon. Land it dead center for PURRFECT. Don't let it topple.

seo.title: Cat Stack: Cat Stacking Game · Play Free Online
seo.description: Play Cat Stack, a free cat stacking game online. Drop sleepy cats from a swinging claw, land them dead center and build a tower to the moon. No download.
seo.h1: Cat Stack: the cat stacking game
seo.imageAlt: Cat Stack: a tower of sleeping cats under the moon, with a cat dangling from a claw above it
intro: Cat Stack is a free one-tap cat stacking game. A sleepy cat swings from a claw above your tower. Tap to drop it, land it on the cat below, and keep building toward the moon. Play it right here in your browser on a phone or a computer.

The tower has real balance. Land off-center a few times on the same side and the whole thing starts to lean, the cats wake up in a panic, and one more sloppy drop sends everyone tumbling. Land dead center and the tower stays straight, the cats purr, and every PURRFECT in a row meows one note higher.
howTo: Tap to start. A cat dangles from a claw that swings left and right above your tower.
Tap anywhere to drop the cat. It falls straight down onto the top of the tower.
Land it dead center for PERFECT (+2 and a coin). From the third PERFECT in a row each one is a PURRFECT worth +3.
Any other landing on the tower scores +1, but it shifts the tower's weight to that side.
Miss the tower completely and you lose one of your 3 paws. Lose all 3 and the run is over.
If the cats above any point lean too far past the cat below them, the tower topples and the run ends. Tap anywhere to retry instantly.
controls: Phone or tablet
Tap the screen to drop the cat
Computer
Press Space, ↓ or Enter (or click) to drop the cat
Retry
Tap or click anywhere after the tower falls
tips: Watch the rhythm of the swing and tap a moment before the cat passes over the tower. The cat falls straight down.
When the screen flashes red and the cats look scared, the tower is leaning. Drop the next cat a little on the other side to pull the weight back.
The claw swings wider and faster the taller your tower gets, so PERFECT streaks early on buy you a straight tower for later.
Chonky cats are wide and heavy. Kittens are small and harder to land on.
Every run pays one coin per PERFECT plus one per 10 points. Spend them in the CAT CAFÉ on 8 litters, from STREET to COSMIC.
Every 10 cats the sky changes: ROOFTOPS, CHIMNEY SMOKE, CLOUD NINE, BAT COUNTRY, THE MOON and DEEP SPACE.
faq: Is Cat Stack free?
Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.
Can I play Cat Stack on my phone?
Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with the keyboard or mouse.
Why did my tower fall over?

Too much weight ended up on one side. Each off-center cat shifts the balance, and when the cats above any point hang past the edge of the cat below, the tower topples. Landing PERFECTs keeps it straight.
What's the difference between PERFECT and PURRFECT?
A PERFECT is a dead-center landing worth +2. Land three or more in a row and each one becomes a PURRFECT worth +3, with a rising meow.
Is my progress saved?
Your best score, coins and cat litters are saved in your browser on this device.

title: Stone Skip
tagline: Tap the moment the stone kisses the water. Chain PERFECT skips and chase the 88-skip world record.

share.title: Stone Skip: can you beat the 88-skip world record?
share.description: A one-tap stone skipping game. Tap the instant the stone touches the water, chain PERFECT skips and chase the real world record of 88.

seo.title: Stone Skip: Stone Skipping Game · Play Free Online
seo.description: Play Stone Skip, a free stone skipping game online. Tap the moment the stone touches the water, chain PERFECT skips and chase the 88-skip world record.
seo.h1: Stone Skip: the stone skipping game
seo.imageAlt: Stone Skip: a flat stone flying over a golden-hour lake, leaving a trail of ripple rings
intro: Stone Skip is a free one-tap stone skipping game. You throw a flat stone across a lake and tap the instant it touches the water to make it bounce again. Every tap is one more skip. Play it right here in your browser on a phone or a computer.

Your target is the real world record: 88 skips in a single throw. A shrinking ring shows exactly where and when the stone will land. Tap as it closes for a PERFECT and the stone flies high and long, and each PERFECT in a row chimes one note higher. Sloppy taps drain momentum, the hops get short and frantic, and the lake keeps changing, from a calm mill pond to a stormy sea.
howTo: Tap to throw. The stone flies off the dock toward the water.
Watch the ring on the water. It shrinks and closes the instant the stone touches down.
Tap as the ring closes. A tap right on time is a PERFECT, a little off is GREAT or OK. Every good tap is one skip.
PERFECT skips refill the MOMENTUM bar and keep the hops high. GREAT refills a little, OK doesn't, and every skip drains some.
Tap too early while the stone is coming down, or don't tap at all, and it sinks with a plunk. If momentum runs out, it sinks too.
Tap anywhere on the game-over card to throw again instantly.
controls: Phone or tablet
Tap the screen when the stone touches the water
Computer
Press Space, Enter or ↑ (or click) to skip
Retry
Tap or click anywhere after the stone sinks
tips: Watch the ring, not the stone. It turns gold during the PERFECT window.
Taps while the stone is still rising are ignored, so you can't be too early on the way up. Only an early tap on the way down sinks it.
The further you get, the shorter and faster the hops and the tighter the timing. Bank PERFECTs early to keep momentum high for later.
When the MOMENTUM bar blinks LOW, only PERFECT skips will save the run.
Every 15 skips the water changes: MILL POND, RIVER BEND, GOLDEN HOUR, MOONLIT BAY, STORM SEA, AURORA FJORD and BEYOND. Bigger waves move the landing spot, so trust the ring.
Each run pays the gems you skip through, plus one per PERFECT and one per 5 skips. Spend them in the ROCK SHOP on 8 stones, from PEBBLE to COMET.
faq: Is Stone Skip free?
Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.
Can I play Stone Skip on my phone?
Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with the keyboard or mouse.
What is the stone skipping world record?
The Guinness World Record is 88 skips, set by Kurt Steiner in Pennsylvania in 2013. Stone Skip uses it as your target. Pass 88 and you get the WORLD RECORD fanfare.
Why did my stone sink?
Either you tapped too early as it came down, you tapped too late (or not at all) after it touched the water, or the MOMENTUM bar ran out. The game-over card tells you which.
Is my progress saved?
Your best score, gems and stones are saved in your browser on this device.
